title: Trapper's Pride
source: camelot.allakhazam.com/quests.html?cquest=308 (retold in our own words; the page gives 42 copper and no experience figure, so a tenth of a level is our choice; the pelts are said to drop from the cubs; levels 1 to 6)
offer: If you want to be of use in Galplen, go and speak to Wariel. She is the trapper, and she is short of pelts.
complete: Fine work. Take this for your trouble.

steps.text: Find Wariel, the trapper, near the bone crossing outside Galplen.
steps.say: I need pelts, and my traps are empty. Bring me five from the lynx cubs in the forest.

steps.text: Hunt tawny lynx cubs in Myrkwood Forest for five pelts.
Bring the five pelts to Wariel.
